description: Repaint this western frontier as one continuous landscape seen from above. On the left are grey snow-capped mountains; they should descend through rocky foothills into open green plains that meet a darker green forest edge on the right. A pale dirt caravan road winds south through the plains and must be kept continuous. Remove the two straight vertical boundary lines and any speckled noise columns; nothing straight or stippled should remain. Keep the same grey, green and brown palette and the same pixel-art style as the surrounding land, and keep the winding road.
